freeze.method: Balanced logistic ranking with bilinear features from 12 whitened components in each modality, five-tick local input and six nearby negative lags, trained on aligned fit excerpts only. Point is the strongest ordinary result on four other people plus 0.03. Positive requires 0.40 temporal IoU and signed offset within 80 ms.
